We need to retrieve details: location of museum (Philadelphia Museum, New York Museum). Sculpture IDs? The user didn't provide IDs. We cannot call get_sculpture_details without sculpture_id. So we can't fetch details. But maybe we can approximate? The instructions say we should use the tool if needed. But we don't have IDs.
